mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP450 inducer that may increase acamprosate metabolism; additionally, both drugs can potentiate CNS depression and additive neurological effects in patients with seizure disorders or alcohol use disorder.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of acamprosate; consider dose adjustment or alternative anticonvulsant if acamprosate efficacy diminishes; counsel on additive CNS depression risk.
